reason: A is the stronger proposal because it specifies a novel, testable extension of prior Al-lightening work to the Mo-containing alloy, with a concrete composition, baseline, measurements, and rejection test. Its main risk is serious—analogous Al addition degraded plasticity and may induce ordered or brittle phases—but B largely repeats the already studied HfMoNbTiZr composition, lacks supporting evidence, and overstates both the expected density reduction and equivalence of Nb and Ta at high temperature.
